name: critical-rce
description: Aggressive first-principles source analysis that retains unique minimized stacks and invariant breaks internally while composing the strongest leads into a complete Critical/RCE filing chain.

schedulingPolicy.internalObjective: lexicographically rank active verified primitives, runtime invariant breaks, unique minimized stack clusters, and source invariant breaks
schedulingPolicy.filingObjective: complete independently replayed Critical/RCE chain only

lanes.title: Pinned-source and authority coordinator
lanes.objective: Freeze one authorized source revision and one buildable component with ASan/UBSan, record supported runtime configurations and program Critical criteria, run the coordinator lie-gate self-test before registering a second worker, and enforce the no-patch-mining discovery boundary. Read checked-in target tests, assertions, invariant comments, fuzz targets, and fixtures as current-revision oracles. Do not consult changelogs, git history or blame, advisories, patched versions, later or earlier revisions, or internet-derived code comparisons.
deliverables: exact source, dependency, build, and runtime identities
recorded no-history and no-patch-diff discovery provenance
inventory of target-owned tests and invariants used as local oracles
frozen component manifest with verified ASan/UBSan instrumentation
passing coordinator-gate.json proving a false worker claim is rejected

lanes.title: Executable differential-witness lead generator
lanes.objective: Use source reading, Trailmark, language frontends, Joern, or Tree-sitter only to identify candidate producer/consumer pairs. Queue nothing from names or static hits. Build two pinned consumers, run both on the same hashed inputs through scripts/differential_witness.py, retain an equal control and a recorded disagreement, and pass those witness specs to scripts/static_analysis_pipeline.py. Bind any Z3 spec to an exact pinned-source fragment with an honest extraction label. Ingest only executed differentials and source-bound constraints with command and artifact provenance.
deliverables: retained tools/static run record with command, stdout, stderr, and status for every selected analyzer
two-consumer differential records containing an equal control and a disagreement
concrete Z3 payloads with verified source binding and explicit extraction provenance where applicable
idempotent provenance-bound validation tasks in tools/static-leads.json and orchestration.db

lanes.title: Attacker ingress and authority mapper
lanes.objective: Derive externally reachable parsers, handlers, message boundaries, authentication states, attacker-controlled fields, and security principals directly from the pinned code and its checked-in configuration. Identify the shortest unauthenticated or low-privilege paths capable of reaching privileged state.
deliverables: public entry-point inventory with exact source references
candidate ingress-to-boundary hypotheses with falsification conditions

lanes.title: Execution and native-sink backtracer
lanes.objective: Work backward from process creation, shell invocation, dynamic module or library loading, executable memory, unsafe native calls, deserialization dispatch, write-then-load, template compilation, and callback or function construction. Record every guard and the attacker-controlled values required to cross it.
deliverables: shortest source-supported routes from a public boundary

lanes.title: Memory, ownership, and lifetime invariant auditor
lanes.objective: Analyze allocation sizes, integer domains, object ownership, pooling, recycling, async completion, error cleanup, cross-thread state, stale views, native handles, and type confusion directly in the pinned source. Prefer primitives that can become controlled read, write, call, or code-loading capability over crash-only outcomes.
deliverables: candidate read, write, type-confusion, and control-flow primitives

lanes.title: Parser, serializer, and representation invariant auditor
lanes.objective: Compare producers and consumers inside the pinned tree for lengths, encodings, duplicate fields, normalization, object shape, signedness, framing, methods, paths, and type domains. For Next, React, and Node targets, first run scripts/framework_analysis_pipeline.py against the production build to turn route manifests, middleware ordering, directives, module identities, caches, runtime branches, and source-to-bundle mappings into concrete runtime hypotheses. Use scripts/structured_input_generator.py to create semantic-grouped JSON, URL, header, multipart, RSC, Server Action, and manifest representations, then run them through persistent workers with scripts/js_coverage_harness.py. Use source-mapped V8/Istanbul coverage and measured holes to redirect generation across server, edge, and client bundles. Seek disagreements that can manufacture executable objects, references, modules, callbacks, native structures, or attacker-directed memory effects. Never treat an analysis hypothesis as a vulnerability verdict.
deliverables: semantic-group manifests and source-mapped JavaScript coverage deltas

lanes.title: Capability, manifest, and code-loading authority auditor
lanes.objective: Trace how the current source authorizes functions, modules, chunks, plugins, templates, paths, callbacks, manifests, RPC methods, and privileged native objects. Identify missing identity, provenance, namespace, or containment checks that could turn data authority into execution authority.

lanes.title: Pinned dependency and integration-boundary auditor
lanes.objective: Use only the target revision's lockfiles, manifests, generated bundles, build graph, and runtime loading evidence to identify exact high-leverage dependencies. Pin selected source under campaign third_party with dependency-add. Audit cross-library trust, representation, lifetime, callback, native, and code-loading boundaries, and preserve dependency primitives for composition with target-owned ingress and sinks. Do not browse history or compare patched versions.
deliverables: exact dependency revisions and target-side lock evidence
dependency primitives with target integration paths
focused chain tasks joining target and dependency bugs

lanes.title: Cross-lane Critical/RCE chain composer
lanes.objective: Continuously combine ingress, invariant violation, primitive, acquisition, and execution-sink evidence from independent workers. Retain unique minimized stacks, invariant breaks, and verified primitives even when no complete chain exists, and create focused tasks for missing links. Reject those partial results only as filings, not as internal search output; mark genuinely falsified leads disproved.
deliverables: new focused tasks for the highest-value gaps
discarded partial chains and exact rejection reasons

lanes.title: Remote coordinate and precondition acquisition
lanes.objective: Prove how an attacker obtains every address, identifier, token, module coordinate, heap fact, build value, timing condition, and carrier used by the candidate without private target artifacts. Replace local-build secrets and harness constants with public protocol output, deterministic derivation, bounded search, or remove the dependency.
deliverables: origin record for every exploit coordinate
measured search, timing, and resource costs

lanes.title: Primitive-to-execution escalation
lanes.objective: Turn the strongest source-confirmed primitive into controlled execution using only functionality naturally present in the stock supported target. Demonstrate attacker-controlled arguments and remove test-only hooks, direct state injection, debugger mutation, forced scheduling, synthetic command callbacks, and application-authored unsafe sinks from the primary chain.
deliverables: bounded real execution terminal or evidence-backed blocker

lanes.title: Stock and supported deployment reachability
lanes.objective: Reproduce the candidate in an unmodified production-equivalent or release build using defaults or a documented supported configuration derived from the pinned tree. For Next.js, React, and Node targets, use scripts/framework_adapter.py to pin the lockfile, runtime, compiler, environment, generated bundles, declared production surfaces, and actual deployment files. Exercise the launched artifact through scripts/http_protocol_harness.py with raw framing and independent attacker/victim sessions; use proxy/framework/origin differential replay where applicable. Development servers, development builds, hot-reload paths, test or fixture servers, preview-only runtimes, and debug-only paths can generate leads but cannot satisfy this lane. Remove bespoke vulnerable callbacks, insecure consumer configuration, local manifest inspection, and unrealistic resource or interaction assumptions.
deliverables: framework adapter manifest and raw protocol-run evidence
explicit remaining platform, topology, resource, and interaction conditions

lanes.title: Critical-chain blocker breakout
lanes.objective: For each blocked chain, classify the missing link as observability, attacker control, reachability, acquisition, reliability, environment, or genuine falsification. Run the smallest first-principles experiment that can remove it, and explore alternative source-derived routes to the same execution boundary. Never route around missing authorization.

lanes.title: Safe stock-target RCE validation
lanes.objective: Execute the complete chain in a disposable owned environment against the unmodified supported production-equivalent or release target, never a development server or development build. Use a bounded real command such as id, whoami, uname, or a timestamp, capture its exact output, prove the process boundary crossed, and avoid credentials, third-party data, persistence, shells beyond the bounded terminal, or destructive effects.
deliverables: retained real command output and process evidence
exact chain conditions and absent artificial mechanisms

lanes.title: Critical controls and fresh-process reliability
lanes.objective: Build a truth table whose positive case differs only in the disputed invariant. Run baseline, enforcing negative, copied or sanitized carrier, restarted-process, and relevant configuration controls. Measure N/M across fresh processes whenever races, allocation, ASLR, retries, or timing affect the result.
deliverables: baseline, negative, and positive truth table
raw outputs, artifact hashes, and cleanup evidence

lanes.title: Finding-scoped independent replay scheduler
lanes.objective: For every surviving chain, register a stable finding and its originating worker, then use schedule-replay twice to create finding-specific tasks that exclude every alias of the originating agent and every prior reviewer agent. Each reviewer must run the retained recipe in fresh processes with new harness-generated challenges and submit a recomputable reality attestation; prose-only passed results are rejected. Do not complete this campaign task until two distinct agents' accepted replays pass machine verification; list every verified finding in taskResult.replayFindings.
deliverables: stable finding IDs and originator identities
accepted independent replay digests and passing machine gates

lanes.title: Critical/RCE claim falsification
lanes.objective: Have fresh workers try to reduce the result to application misuse, insecure configuration, unavailable attacker coordinates, resource exhaustion, a crash-only primitive, unsupported code, synthetic evidence, or an unproven boundary. Independently walk the exact source-to-sink path, enumerate every conditional and concrete attacker-selected outcome, search for contradictions, and refuse unresolved assumptions. Re-run source and runtime evidence but do not use history, patch diffs, advisories, or internet-derived code comparisons.
deliverables: executable path proof with recomputed observations and zero unresolved assumptions

lanes.title: Critical/RCE chain synthesis and package
lanes.objective: Package only a chain that proves attacker input through the violated invariant and stock primitive to bounded real code execution, or another program-defined Critical boundary with equivalent concrete impact. Require a passing linked path proof whose ordered steps and branches are bound to recomputed assertions from raw process output, whose source snapshots and targets are hashed, whose assumptions are empty, and whose reviewer independently executed the same recipe with new challenges. If the chain does not meet that bar, retain it as blocked or disproved rather than produce a lower-severity report.
deliverables: complete hashes, conditions, controls, and cleanup record
